newsitem.title: UK: Safeway shares drop after trading statement.
newsitem.headline: Safeway shares drop after trading statement.

text.p: Shares in Safeway Plc dropped in early trading on Friday after the supermarket operator warned that profits could be hit by a slowdown in sales growth in the first 16 weeks of the second half of the current year.

The stock was down 13p at 376 by 0804 GMT. Safeway said total sales rose 9.7 percent in the five week Christmas period to January 4, but said over the first 16 weeks of the second half which ends in March and "in common with the sector, sales growth in existing stores has slowed."

"Were this to continue, profits for the remaining eight weeks of the current year might be affected," Safeway said. "Nevertheless we are confident that Safeway is well positioned to deliver a further year of solid profit growth."
Other supermarket stocks also dropped, with Tesco Plc down 7p at 356 by 0807 GMT, J Sainsbury Plc down 3-1/2p at 325 and ASDA Group Plc down 3p at 118.
By 0812 GMT Safeway shares were down 18p at 371.
